components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action on the stall; reaches a live-goods anchor or a real state change.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; padding: 0 24px; background: #c2410c; border: 2px solid #2a1738; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 2px; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a5360a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c2410c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A square card-ground action with a sign border; hover shifts to the brand tint.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 0 20px; background: #fffcf1; border: 2px solid #2a1738; color: #2a1738; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #c2410c; color: #c2410c; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c2410c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Button
components.description: A square sign filter with a live count; the active state inverts the sign.
components.css: .ds-filter { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px; background: #2a1738; border: 2px solid #2a1738; color: #fff3dc; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter span { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="false"] { background: #fffcf1; color: #2a1738; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="false"] span { color: #c2410c; opacity: 1; } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c2410c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-tag { position: relative; display: block; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 24px 16px 16px; border: 2px solid #2a1738; background: #fffcf1; color: #2a1738; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-tag::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 50%; width: 8px; height: 8px; transform: translateX(-50%); border: 2px solid #2a1738; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff3dc; } .ds-tag-media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: #f5e7c9; border: 1px solid #2a1738; overflow: hidden; } .ds-tag-category { margin: 16px 0 0; color: #5b4566; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tag h3 { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-tag-fields { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 2px solid #2a1738; } .ds-tag-price { font-family: Bungee, Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-tag-stock { padding: 4px 8px; background: #f4b740; border: 1px solid #2a1738; color: #171029; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tag-view { margin: 16px 0 0; color: #c2410c; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tag:hover { border-color: #c2410c; } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c2410c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sign Panel
components.description: A square card-interior schedule with hairline rules for fee data.
components.css: .ds-sign-panel { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 16px; border: 2px solid #2a1738; background: #fffcf1; color: #2a1738; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-sign-panel div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #bfa984; } .ds-sign-panel div:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; border-bottom: 0; padding-top: 12px; } .ds-sign-panel dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: #c2410c; }

components.css: .ds-delivery-board { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; } .ds-bulb-string { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding-top: 6px; } .ds-bulb-string::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 4%; right: 4%; border-top: 2px solid #2a1738; } .ds-bulb-string span { display: block; width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 2px solid #2a1738; border-radius: 999px; background: #f4b740; animation: ds-bulb-on 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-bulb-string span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 110ms; } .ds-bulb-string span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 220ms; } .ds-bulb-string span:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 330ms; } .ds-bulb-string span:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 440ms; } @keyframes ds-bulb-on { from { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.85); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } } .ds-sign-solid { padding: 24px 20px; border: 2px solid #2a1738; background: #2a1738; color: #fff3dc; text-align: center; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-sign-solid p { margin: 0; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-sign-solid strong { display: block; margin-top: 16px; font-family: Bungee, Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-bulb-string span { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The storefront is a stall at dusk: goods hung on a board, prices painted on square paper tags, and a warm bulb strand strung above the payment sign. It replaces the waybill / delivery-slip identity wholesale rather than polishing it. The world is built from heavy 2px sign borders, ivory canvas and aubergine ink, one burnt-orange action color, and a single authored moment of bulbs coming on. Metaphor never stands in front of merchandise — the live goods cards are the hero, and the cash-on-delivery board is the one memorable fixture.

The system is flat, squared-off, and legible at a glance under a night-market's warm light. Bungee paints the sign lettering, Karla carries the prose, and Roboto Mono prints every figure that changes with a live read. Product photography stays API-supplied; no local raster ships and no inventory, price, or social proof is invented. Loading, empty, and failed reads are stated honestly in the stall's own language.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory canvas with aubergine sign ink in light mode; deep aubergine night ground and ivory ink in dark mode.
One action color, #c2410c, reserved for actions and live signals; a lighter #ffb27a only for text on dark surfaces.
Painted-sign display (Bungee), readable body (Karla), tabular mono figures (Roboto Mono).
Square paper tags with a 2px border and a single punched hole; round bulbs are the only soft geometry.
Flat surfaces, no shadows or gradients, one bulb-strand entrance, and themed browser chrome.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Burnt orange is the only accent. If an element is not an action or a live signal, it does not get the accent.

rules.name: The Bulb Contrast Rule
rules.body: Bulb yellow always carries aubergine ink (#171029), in light and dark alike. Ivory on bulb is 1.6:1 and is never shipped.

rules.name: The Live-Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number that came from the API — price, stock, counts, the delivery fee — is Roboto Mono with tabular numerals. Explanatory prose is Karla. Mono is data, not a technical costume.

rules.name: The Flat Stall Rule
rules.body: No ambient shadows, lifted cards, or gradient washes. A zero-offset colored halo is decoration, not depth, and is not used for the bulbs either.

dos: Do read prices, stock, categories, and product names from the live API and show the honest failure state when a read fails.
Do keep primary buttons #c2410c in both themes; use #ffb27a only for text and links on dark aubergine surfaces.
Do keep bulb-yellow badges on #171029 ink in both themes.
Do draw structure with 2px sign borders, square panels, 2px radii, and punched tags.
Do keep CTAs on working anchors, built routes, honest placeholders, or real state changes, with targets at least 44px tall.
Do theme selection, caret, scrollbars, focus rings, and underline offset from the palette.
Do leave product photography to API-supplied URLs; this system ships no local raster.
donts: Don't return to the waybill: no field numbers, carbon-copy separations, double-rule stamps, or rounded 24px paper panels.
Don't use shadows, gradients, glass, grain, or a zero-offset glow halo; the bulbs animate with opacity and transform only.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading; the Bungee sign face carries its own weight.
Don't set body prose in mono or live figures in Karla; each face has one job.
Don't use Impact or Arial Black as the shipped display face — Bungee is self-hosted through next/font.
Don't invent inventory, testimonials, delivery dates, or social proof, or present the cart placeholder as checkout.
Don't hide goods behind hover, carousels, or decorative panels; the live tags are the hero.
